title: From surface to bulk modification: Plasma polymerization of amine-bearing coating by synergic strategy of biomolecule grafting and nitric oxide loading

notes: Spine: need -> amine-rich PPAm platform -> NO loading of PPAm gives a ~1 h burst (F2b) -> down-select of the PPAmF C-F multilayer -> BVLD grafting then NO loading -> two branches (surface BVLD with retained anti-thrombin activity; bulk NONOates with prolonged release) -> joint platelet suppression -> AV-shunt thromboresistance -> conclusion. Lost: PPAm vs PPAmF matched release (Fig. S5), C-F films (S2-S4), N1s XPS (S6), contact angles (S7), amine derivatisation XPS (Supp. Table 1). Packet inconsistencies: F3c caption says BVLD grafted on NO-PPAmF while the text orders BVLD grafting before NO loading; F5 caption 2 h vs text 30 min PRP exposure; F3 caption typo 'BLVD'; text writes cm-2 for IR bands; text fold reductions for platelet adhesion (2.1, 1.2) equal (ratio - 1) of the F5b bars. Audit a1 (text-silent): the C-F band nearly vanishes from NO-loaded PPAmF spectra, so the intact C-F barrier assumed by n24/n16 is not shown after NO loading.
